wilson_mapping: N beta = beta_W/N = 2/g^2, so beta=2/(N g^2)
stability_lemma: If an added C2 effective interaction Phi has Hess Phi >= -epsilon I uniformly in volume, Bakry-Emery curvature remains >= K_S-epsilon. Thus epsilon<K_S preserves the finite-volume LSI/Poincare constant uniformly in volume.
